run_compare_leduc: run the comparison of Jax CFR against original CFR on the Leduc poker game
run_compare_battleship: run the comparison of Jax CFR against original CFR on the battleship game
run_compare_goofspiel_descending: run the comparison of Jax CFR against original CFR on the descending Goofspiel game
